notes:
v4.6.46 — Cleaner handling of coins IBKR doesn't support

🐛 IMPROVED — IBKR crypto on coins IBKR doesn't list (e.g. ONDO)
• Interactive Brokers only offers a limited set of cryptocurrencies (BTC, ETH, LTC, BCH, and some others). For a coin IBKR doesn't list — like ONDO — IBKR returns 'no security definition', which previously produced a confusing 4-line error cascade on EVERY cycle.
• Now the bot detects an unsupported coin once, SKIPS it cleanly with a single clear message ('isn't tradeable on IBKR — run this crypto bot on Alpaca for full coin coverage'), and stops re-trying it. No more error spam.

👉 Bottom line: to trade ONDO and most altcoins, run your crypto bot on ALPACA (full coin support). Use IBKR for stocks (LONG / SHORT / DAY) — they can run at the same time. IBKR crypto works only for the major coins IBKR actually lists.

Update normally via the in-app banner. Restart any bot running on Oracle to pick up the change.
